papers.title: Anharmonic superconducting density functional theory: A general framework for superconductivity with anharmonic corrections
papers.abstract: An First-principles studies of superconductivity often neglect anharmonic effects (AHE), despite their crucial role in achieving quantitative accuracy in many materials. To bridge this gap, we introduce a general computational approach, termed anharmonic superconducting density functional theory (ah-SC…
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“First-principles studies”（第一性原理研究）、“introduce a general computational approach”（引入通用计算方法）以及理论框架名称“anharmonic superconducting density functional theory (ah-SCDFT)”。；研究对象：超导体的量子现象，具体是超导态中晶格振动（声子）的非简谐效应（anharmonic effects, AHE）对超导性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出非简谐效应对于实现超导研究的定量准确性至关重要，而现有第一性原理研究常忽略这一点。该工作旨在通过提出新理论框架来弥补这一空白。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论，但指出非简谐效应对于实现超导研究的定量准确性至关重要，而现有第一性原理研究常忽略这一点。该工作旨在通过提出新理论框架来弥补这一空白。；创新点：将非简谐效应系统地纳入超导密度泛函理论（SCDFT）的框架中，建立了一个能够更准确描述真实材料中超导性的第一性原理计算方法。摘要未突出说明与现有具体方法的性能对比。
papers.method_zh: 提出了一个名为“非简谐超导密度泛函理论（ah-SCDFT）”的通用计算框架。该方法是在超导密度泛函理论（SCDFT）的基础上，显式地引入并处理非简谐修正。

papers.title: Quantitative thermodynamic study of superconducting and normal states in ${\mathrm{UTe}}_{2}$ under pressure
papers.abstract: Author(s): T. Vasina, M. Pfeiffer, R. Borth, M. Nicklas, M. Amano Patino, G. Lapertot, J.-P. Brison, E. Hassinger, G. Knebel, and D. Braithwaite Pressurized UTe2 exhibits a complex landscape of superconducting and magnetic phases. Here, the authors present a quantitative specific heat study under pressure that probes the increase of electronic correlations, through a threefold enhancement of the Sommerfeld coefficient with pressure, reveals some of the complex interactions between the different phases, and sheds new light on several puzzles of this unusual material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“quantitative specific heat study under pressure”（定量比热研究），属于实验手段。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是UTe₂（铀基超导体），重点研究其在压力下的超导态和正常态的热力学性质，以及伴随的压力诱导的电子关联增强和超导-磁相之间的复杂相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过压力下的比热测量，发现Sommerfeld系数（电子比热系数）随压力增加而增强约三倍，表明电子关联显著增强；同时揭示了不同超导相与磁相之间的复杂相互作用，为理解UTe₂中若干未解之谜提供了新线索。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过压力下的比热测量，发现Sommerfeld系数（电子比热系数）随压力增加而增强约三倍，表明电子关联显著增强；同时揭示了不同超导相与磁相之间的复杂相互作用，为理解UTe₂中若干未解之谜提供了新线索。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 具体采用了压力下的定量比热测量（specific heat study under pressure），通过分析比热数据提取Sommerfeld系数等热力学量，研究电子关联随压力的变化。
keywords: electronic structure and strongly correlated systems

papers.title: Anyon dispersion in Aharonov-Casher bands and implications for twisted ${\mathrm{MoTe}}_{2}$
papers.abstract: Author(s): Zihan Yan, Qingchen Li, Tomohiro Soejima (副島智大), and Eslam Khalaf Here, the authors develop a microscopic theory of dispersing anyons in fractional quantum anomalous Hall systems and a momentum-space Monte Carlo framework to evaluate quasihole energies. By constructing momentum-resolved Laughlin quasihole states in Aharonov-Casher bands, they compute anyon bandwidths relevant to twisted MoTe2 and show how nonuniform quantum geometry, together with the quasihole Berry phase, gives rise to finite dispersion, opening a route toward controlled theories of itinerant anyon phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop a microscopic theory”、“momentum-space Monte Carlo framework”、“compute quasihole energies”。；研究对象：分数量子反常霍尔系统中的任意子（anyon）色散行为，具体以扭曲二碲化钼（twisted MoTe₂）为研究对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Aharonov-Casher能带中，非均匀的量子几何与准空穴贝里相位共同导致任意子具有有限色散（即有限带宽），从而为研究可移动任意子相提供了可控理论途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Aharonov-Casher能带中，非均匀的量子几何与准空穴贝里相位共同导致任意子具有有限色散（即有限带宽），从而为研究可移动任意子相提供了可控理论途径。；创新点：首次建立了描述分数量子反常霍尔系统中色散任意子的微观理论，并提出了计算任意子带宽的具体方法，揭示了非均匀量子几何在任意子色散中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 构建了动量分辨的Laughlin准空穴态，并开发了动量空间蒙特卡洛（momentum-space Monte Carlo）框架来评估准空穴能量，从而计算任意子带宽。

papers.title: Kondo effect in ferromagnetic quantum critical ${\mathrm{CeRh}}_{6}{\mathrm{Ge}}_{4}$
papers.abstract: The nature of cerium’s 4f electron is key to understanding the mechanism of pressure-induced quantum criticality in the heavy-fermion ferromagnet CeRh6Ge4. Combining core-level photoemission and polarized x-ray absorption spectroscopy with simulations based on the single-impurity Anderson model, the authors demonstrate here that Kondo hybridization admixes higher-lying crystal field states into a multiorbital ground state with a 4f occupancy nf ~ 0.9, which also accounts for the dynamical spin response. The results establish the importance of Kondo hybridization and the resulting multiorbital ground state as essential components for a model of quantum criticality.

papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变PbTe纳米线的横截面积（即量子点尺寸），追踪充电能量的演化，发现大横截面积下充电能量缺失，从而澄清了此前关于PbTe量子点中充电能量存在与否的争议。

In this geometry, a longitudinal phase bias generates transverse super…
